card.title: You Handle the Evidence
card.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the raffle cashbox in your office till the treasurer comes. I can't face explaining the broken lock.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then take it home. You can hand it to her tomorrow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll want me to count it with her.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. You handle the count and explain the lock; I'll send you the key that snapped.

mechanism: A transfers custody of problematic evidence and expands B's follow-up responsibility to avoid explaining a broken lock.
confusable: Unlike innocent storage delegation, A must shift the difficult accountability along with the object.
comparison: The cashbox helper inherits counting and explanation; the receipt helper inherits contact and coordination without physical custody.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
